title: Page 39
transc:
SH Beckwith
Culpeper ----  Washn Apl 16th 1864 
Topsy For chart tulip Paxton Kautz will be sent to
grapes if you deem him more use full there than
here in charge of pedlar bureau Yacht There is no
competent person here to take his place and the difficulty
of getting silvers is daily increasing yardstick Could you not
employ Mystic to advantage on the Aurora wafer Valley He
is anxious for active employment yacht There is a wayne
of Simms pagan in Baron drilled as Star Jones yoke
strong which could be sent to the field if you
think it can be spared from Opals princeton tulip His
last returns give his Richland Salem Clarke Seward Cushing Smith
pike since then Gilbert Snyder have been sent to Chapel
yawl Cupid Spunky Shark and Chief of Satan & so
